_help.about: (29 Oct) The song web. Each realm has a key (a plant, rarely a mineral); bring the shaman a cutting and he teaches its song. The hub's platter starts with three keys. Every realm offers three: the key that brought you plus two that lead on. 'grows_in' is where its cutting can be taken. Entries marked open are Mike's to fill (§GK.9 call 2). Wired 30 Oct (queue 116 amended, SongWeb): platter, keys, hub_platter, cuttings, look; doors and keeper are queue 117's, loot queue 119's.
_help.realms: key -> realm it opens. Names are working names.

hub_platter._help: (§GK.2.2, Claude Code's first guesses) The platter at the hub fire: a woven tray on a flat stone, from_fire_m from the fire's middle, bearing_deg round from the shaman's side toward where you wake (0 his side, 90 your side), one cutting of each platter key on it. The interact button within reach_m takes the one you look at into your pack. others_stay true: the two you did not choose stay on the platter (your choice decides your first realm, and the others wait if you come back for them); false: choosing one clears the platter. Mike's call.
hub_platter._help_look: look_cos: how straight you must look at a cutting to take it (the cosine of the angle off your line of sight; 0.9 is about 25 degrees). Looking at the fire instead, the button sits you down.
hub_platter.log_take: You take the {name} from the platter.

cuttings._help: (§GK.2.1, §GK.2.3, Claude Code's first guesses) Key plants growing in a realm (keys.<key>.grows_in holds the realm's id, crawler.json areas.<area>.realm): plants_per_key living plants of each, seeded on its floor, from_hearth_m or more from its hearth and apart_m apart. The interact button within reach_m takes a cutting (an item, key_cutting); the plant stays, and you carry one cutting of a key at a time. Where §GL.3 puts them (the realm's end, a side path) is queue 121's. Give a cutting to the shaman (by him or the fire, the interact button) and he teaches its song; one whose song you know he hands back.
cuttings.log_take: You take a cutting of the {name}.
cuttings.log_teach: He turns the {name} in his hands. "Go fetch me a plant, and I'll teach you its song." He begins to sing.
cuttings.log_known: He hands the {name} back. "That song you have."
cuttings.log_ask: The shaman looks up from the fire. "Bring me a plant, and I'll teach you its song."

look._help: Each key's name and colours (body, accent) for its cutting on the platter and its living plant in a realm. Claude Code's first guesses.
